human_decisions_incorporated.decision: Use Critical, High, Medium, and Low, matching Ticket.Priority's allowed values while keeping urgency a separate business attribute with no mapping.

Support Agent access is limited to currently assigned tickets; Support Manager access is limited to currently assigned teams including team-queued tickets; Tenant Admin access covers any ticket in their tenant; Platform Admin has no individual ticket urgency access.

Accept copies SuggestedUrgency to ReviewedUrgency; override stores the selected valid urgency. Preserve SuggestedUrgency and reviewer/time metadata. Urgency review never changes Ticket.Priority; any Priority change uses FR-TM-14.

changed_sections: §5.9 centralized permission catalogue and TicketAIResult role mapping
removed_or_superseded: The unspecified/configured urgency value set is replaced by Critical, High, Medium, and Low.
The unspecified urgency reviewer scope is replaced by the explicit existing-role and ticket-scope rules in FR-TK-09.
Any implication that urgency review changes Ticket.Priority is explicitly excluded; Priority changes remain under FR-TM-14.
scope_changes: No unrelated scope added. No role, permission-grant mechanism, or exception added. TicketAIResult read/review is expressed through the existing centralized default-deny role/resource/action authorization mechanism.
